title: Absolute Equality number one
bio: Houston-based artist known for large-scale public works exploring justice and identity. Commissioned through the Juneteenth Legacy Project.
desc: Covering 5,000 sq ft, this landmark mural honors Galveston as the Birthplace of Juneteenth.

title: Greetings From Galveston
bio: Local Galveston artist celebrated for colorful murals blending coastal imagery with bold typography.
desc: Painted in vintage postcard style, each letter highlights a different facet of Galveston.

title: I Love Galveston
bio: Local Galveston artist known for colorful murals blending coastal imagery with bold typography.
desc: Marine life surrounds a hand-lettered 'i ❤️ galveston' in this beloved coastal mural.

title: Postoffice Street Collection
bio: A 2025 series by local and visiting artists adding fresh color to the Cultural Arts District.
desc: New murals along storefronts reflecting the creative energy of Post Office Street.

title: Huli Huli Hut Mural
bio: Galveston-based muralist whose tropical coastal style brings warmth and energy to island businesses.
desc: A surfer gazing over the Gulf in bold tropical colors — pure island spirit.

title: Stay Beach Box Mural
bio: Galveston artist exploring spray paint techniques through large-format public commissions.
desc: Bold coastal imagery adding color and energy to the Rosenberg Ave corridor.

title: Do You Hear the Sound of Galveston?
bio: Latin American artist whose large-scale works engage with local history and architecture.
desc: A 20×50ft mural honoring conductor Willard Dickerson, who broke racial barriers in Galveston schools.
